# THUMBNAIL.md — Deep Canopy (test fixture)

Thumbnail grammar for this channel. Language and boundaries, never a template.

## Visual grammar

Depth into the trees: trunks, canopy, a path of light. The forest itself is the subject.

## Typography

Little or no type. If any, a light serif in off-white.

## Text

Prefer no text.

## Colour direction

Greens and browns from the footage, soft contrast. No teal-orange grading.

## Subject emphasis

The forest interior. Water is a supporting element only when the film has it.

## Composition

Layers front to back. A light source or clearing as the focal point.

## Acceptable layout families

Full-bleed frame. Full-bleed frame with a small wordmark.

## Avoid

Faces. Arrows. Saturated overlays. Cloned competitor framing.
